📋 How to fill the template & which sheets are needed
✅ Core — Dashboard works with just these:
• ASIN_MAPPER — fill manually
• CAMPAIGN_MAPPER — fill manually
• CE_MTD — Campaign Export download
• BR_MTD — Business Report download
+ Optional — unlocks more tabs:
CE_PMTD / L7D / P7D → MoM comparisons
CE_Daily_MTD/PMTD → Daily trend charts
SP/SB_STR_IS → Search term deep dive
PLACEMENT → Placement analysis tab
SP/SD_ASIN → ASIN-level ad analysis
BR_PMTD/L7D/P7D → BR period comparisons
Whatever sheets are present in your file will be used. Missing sheets simply disable those sections — no errors.

Single .xlsx file with all 3 sheets
SP_Budget_report SP_Hourly_report Campaign_Mapper
📋 Template File
📅
SP_Budget_report_L30
Date-wise SP budget report. Required columns: Date, Portfolio name, Campaign Name, Spend, 14 Day Total Orders (#), 14 Day Total Sales, Budget Amount, Status
⏱
SP_Hourly_report
Hourly SP performance (L14 recommended). Required: Start Date, Start Time, Campaign Name, Spend, 14 Day Total Orders (#), Impressions, Clicks
🗂
Campaign_Mapper
Campaign classification. Required: Campaign (name), BCG (Branded/Gen/Comp/Mix), Category, Targeting, Match type
⚙ How it works: Upload your Excel file above, configure settings in each tab, then generate your Budget Plan and Day Parting rules. All processing happens in your browser — no data is sent to any server. Works for any brand using Amazon SP campaigns.

Day Parting Rules — Amazon Drona Configuration

4 Rules · Daily Schedule
How rules work: Each campaign is assigned to exactly one rule based on BCG tag and spend tier. In Amazon Drona → Automated Rules → Campaign rule/Budget Day Parting → Daily schedule. Empty hour fields default to 1.0×.
